content:
maria: Heads-up — hotpatch v2.3.1 cutover in 50m, need 2 approvals before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/9123 
leo: On it, will do a quick pass in ~15m. 
sarah: I can take final review after standup, ~25–30m. 
oliver: @maria quick question — is this dependent on the infra migration branch? last I saw that was still rolling.
maria: infra migration finished earlier today, not blocking. the only thing left is a flaky kv-cache unit test failing in CI intermittently. small tweak in the PR to warm the cache.
tiffany: tagging release-approvers: @leo @sarah please prioritize — I'm on rollback standby if anything smells off :rotating_light: 
leo: left 2 small comments about `connection_timeout` default. can we bump to `6000ms`? if eng-runtime signs off i'll re-approve.
ben: (eng-runtime) quick eyeball — bumping to `6000ms` safe for the new batcher. no perf regressions locally :+1:
leo: thanks @ben, updating now.
sarah: reading — looks fine, just want to run smoke locally. will report back in 10m.
deploy-bot: preflight checks started for PR #9123 — lint ✅, unit tests partially green (kv-cache flaky), smoke scheduled.
maria: if both @leo and @sarah can drop approvals within the next 30m we can hit the deploy window. otherwise we bump to the next slot.
leo: approved. :white_check_mark:
sarah: approving after local smoke — LGTM. :shipit:
tiffany: copy — scheduling canary at +10m after merge, I'll monitor errors and token-level latencies. ping me in #eng-oncall if anything spikes.
maria: thanks all — merging in 5m once CI finishes the final run. will post rollback plan if canary shows regressions.
deploy-bot: merge gate passed. PR #9123 merged by maria. canary deploy started.
maria: canary healthy at +3m, latency and error rates normal. closing this thread. :tada:
